dialogues.speaker: Sanada
dialogues.text: Ah, why am I the only one left here again... Hello, how can I help you?

dialogues.speaker: Sanada
dialogues.text: I have a comrade who was supposed to stand on guard with me, but he always abandons his post. If I don't pay special attention, he tends to just leave me on duty here alone.

dialogues.speaker: Sanada
dialogues.text: I'm debating if I should report this to our superior...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you ever seen someone who looks like me?

dialogues.speaker: Sanada
dialogues.text: I can't really say. There are way too many people coming in and out of Hanamizaka. And I'm usually the only one on duty. How can I possibly remember that?

dialogues.speaker: Sanada
dialogues.text: Gee, can't people just do their job properly...

dialogues.speaker: Sanada
dialogues.text: Glory to the Shogun and her everlasting reign! Let me think...

dialogues.speaker: Sanada
dialogues.text: If this gets out, everyone will think that I'm a snitch. What if they ostracize me from now on because of that?

dialogues.speaker: Sanada
dialogues.text: I don't want to have a bad reputation at the Police Station. It will affect my chances for a promotion...

dialogues.speaker: Sanada
dialogues.text: But what if there is trouble? How am I supposed to handle it myself?

dialogues.speaker: Sanada
dialogues.text: I have to patrol this whole area. This is too difficult. Ah, so annoying...
